questions.question: Calculate the magnitude of the resultant force exerted by the two tugs on the motorboat.

questions.model_answer: Assuming each tug applies a force of 500 N, the horizontal components of the forces are 500 cos(40°) N each. The vertical components are 500 sin(40°) N each. The horizontal components cancel out, and the vertical components add up to 2 * 500 sin(40°) N. Resultant force = sqrt((2 * 500 sin(40°))^2) = 670.82 N.
questions.explanation: The forces from the tugs are symmetrical, so the horizontal components cancel out. The vertical components add up to give the total vertical force, which is the resultant force.
